likely_causes.cause: Furnace switch or door switch open
Thermostat not calling for fan or cool

homeowner_checks: Flip the furnace switch fully Off then On
Confirm the blower door is seated
Set thermostat Fan to On briefly and listen
Check the filter is not collapsed against the rack
tech_only: Any line-voltage work inside the air handler
call_pro_when: A fan or cool call is present but blower amps stay near zero after door/switch checks.
assumptions: Optocoupler call inputs are installed when call_g/call_y are trusted
